reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_missing, COUNT(c.category_id) AS n_matched
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_raw
WHERE p.category_id IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_missing, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.category_name = p.category_raw)) AS n_matched FROM products p WHERE p.category_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_missing, SUM(CASE WHEN c.category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_matched FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_raw WHERE p.category_id IS NULL

other_way.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_missing, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.category_name = p.category_raw)) AS n_matched FROM products p WHERE p.category_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: EXISTS asks the yes or no question for each product without a join, but the LEFT JOIN can also return the category it found.
